_readme: Junie owns the session mode ids and the tool names below. LeapMux owns no value in this file. Both sides read them -- the worker falls back to the safe mode and maps the `spawn_subagent` call to a subagent registry row, and the browser plugin wires the plan toggle and draws the same call from the same words. Junie stamps no tool name on an ACP tool call: `title` is the call's display label, so the subagent mapping reads the `agent` and `handle` fields of `rawInput` that only `spawn_subagent` carries.
